title: Among the accounts who have loan validity more than 12 months, list out the
question:
Among the accounts who have loan validity more than 12 months, list out the accounts that have the highest approved amount and have account opening date in 1993.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Loan validity more than 12 months refers to duration > 12

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
WHERE l.XCL_036 > 12
  AND a.XCL_004 LIKE '1993%'
  AND l.XCL_038 = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.XCL_038)
    FROM loan l2
    JOIN account a2 ON l2.XCL_034 = a2.XCL_001
    WHERE l2.XCL_036 > 12
      AND a2.XCL_004 LIKE '1993%'
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
WHERE l.XCL_037 > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.XCL_004) = '1993'
ORDER BY l.XCL_036 DESC
LIMIT 1;
